mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) levels reduce the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% compared to when it is above (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, raising equity discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly lower when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% compared to when it is below (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 4.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 210.0, it signals stagflation, increasing equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both conditions hold (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 signals a weakening housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 in late-cycle expansion (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals a contraction in the supply sector, increasing economic uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) drops below 350000, it signals a severe housing market downturn, increasing equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both conditions hold (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL above 211.0) signals a loss of monetary policy control, increasing equity risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 211.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
